data_output.description: The fixed training command must write predictions_valid.npz containing exactly two arrays: row_ids and scores. row_ids must be int64 values np.arange(len(validation_rows)) in the canonical validation input order, and scores must be a finite one-dimensional float array of identical length containing the checkpoint predictions for those rows. No ground-truth labels or additional arrays may be written; the fixed evaluator owns ground-truth loading and metric computation.

model_input.description: The model receives encoded feature rows with the existing additive user/item index layout. Pairwise training receives one positive and one negative impression from the same user, skips users lacking either class, and optimizes the ordering margin between their additive logits. Prediction remains a one-dimensional score per validation row, with no representation or feature-schema changes.
